notes: SEARCH BUDGET: all 6 WebSearch calls used (cap reached). FETCHES: about 22 of 60 used. Records come only from organizer, venue or calendar pages (waukeshacardshow.com, premiercardshows.com, madisoncardshow.com, hollywoodshow.com). treasurehunter.show and thecardshopfinder.com are on the never-fetch list, so they supplied leads only. MISTAKE TO FLAG: I called the spawn_task tool once by accident with a placeholder title. It created a pending task chip, task_57e20752 titled 'placeholder', that the user can see. I did not call dismiss_task because my brief forbids task tools. Please dismiss it. NOTES ON RECORDS: (1) The Hollywood Show homepage footer says 2019 and the Chicago page is undated, so confidence is medium. The homepage 'must be in our hands by October 9th, 2026' deadline is not tied to any show, so it was not used. Its Chicago admission prices were not on the page, so admission is left out. (2) Premier Card Shows lists only Oct 24 (Janesville) and Oct 31 (Hoffman Estates) on its own site. Its vendor link is a registration form that asks for an account, which I did not create. (3) Madison Card Show: the organizer homepage is dated Oct 12, 2026 and lists no shows after July 25, but its Jan 9, 2026 schedule post gives 2026 dates under a '2026 Schedule at a Glance' heading, not beside each date. Those later dates are medium confidence. Venue addresses are not on the organizer pages, so they are left out. Its table purchase page lists no products and no prices. (4) Waukesha: the dealers page prices come from an undated page. It mentions an 'October 17th' show without a year and says 'as of Thursday, October 15th', which fits 2026 by weekday. The Oct 17 show is not on the homepage, so it is not recorded. CardShopFinder lists a Sept 12, 2026 Waukesha show that the organizer does not list; the April 10, 2027 date does match the organizer. Series have no last_confirmed because the organizer page has no post date with a year. (5) Indiana: no organizer or venue page was found for any Indiana show. All Indiana leads are listing-site only. (6) Not run because of budget: site:eventeny.com searches, and the fairgrounds and expo center searches for Indiana and Wisconsin. Not found, not blocked: waukeshaexpo.com, gatherings43.com, prairieeventscenter.com and schaumburgcardshow.com did not resolve. alliantenergycenter.com/events returned 404. The Dallas Card Show, Chicago Sports Spectacular, The National, JJ All Star, Indianapolis and TCG-Kon lines were skipped as covered elsewhere or known.
